review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines two scalar functions, kaplanskyTransform (2t/(1+t²)) and kaplanskyInverse (t/(1+√(1-t²))), plus lemmas about them using the existing cfc API. I searched Mathlib for the same rational expression. The only hits were in PythagoreanTriples, where it appears inline as a point on the circle in the stereographic parametrisation. That is not a named real-function definition, so it isn't a competing concept. I found no Mathlib definition for this transform or its inverse on [-1,1]. The cfc lemmas (norm_cfc_le, cfc_comp, cfc_congr, cfc_id) are used rather than redefined. So I found no avoidable duplicate.
